# npm-plugin-kit
> A simple npm-based plugin system for installing and loading JavaScript or TypeScript capabilities.
Canonical project page: https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/npm-plugin-kit/
GitHub: https://github.com/imba97/npm-plugin-kit
Status: documented candidate
Last verified: 2026-11-17
